notes.title: Bug Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue that was causing ambient noise on the Subway level to not be affected by volume settings.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix - Spanish Language is now a visible option.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Visibility for the Spanish language was set to hidden, unintentionally. The Spanish button should properly show now.
[/list]

notes.title: A Small Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed "Camera Anomaly" from the report options to avoid confusion.
[*] Fixed a small bug that could be caused by hitting escape during the win screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Performance and Bug Fix!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] We have optimized the lighting in the game to be more performant and allow for higher FPS.
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing single player escape menu to pause the game, but not allow players to quit without opening the menu again. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update & Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Tutorial interface added for new players.
[*] Room and anomaly options will now highlight if not selected when reporting.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused anomalies to be generated inconsistently near the end of levels.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Hard mode to not generate the correct amount of anomalies. Hard mode will now be drastically harder.
[*] Fixed possible issue causing crashes on versus mode.
[*] Fixed issue with double reporting on versus mode.
[/list]

For any players having a "fatal error" bug, please post to us on the discussion forums with your computer hardware and when the error is occurring. This will help us greatly!

notes.title: 1.0 Full Release!
notes.content: Observe and Report is now fully released! Hop on security duty and report anomalies in two new maps: Convenience and Shopping.

notes.title: Small Update - Pause Fixed
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Pressing escape to access the escape menu, during single player gameplay, will now properly pause the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1 - B-Patch
notes.content: We have resolved an issue with localizations not packaging with the game properly.

notes.title: Update #1 - Languages added & Small Fixes!
notes.content:
[h2]New Languages![/h2]
[list]
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Filipino
[*] Porteguese
[*] Polish
[*] Russian
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the options menu causing the back button to create an unwanted UI screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with escape being required to be pressed twice to open the escape menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with reporting in versus mode.
[/list]
